catalog.name: Semester Study & Exam Revision Pack
catalog.description: Structured semester syllabus tracker, spaced-repetition revision checklist, and exam formula template.

digitalContent.title: KAMPUS Semester Revision Blueprint
digitalContent.instructions: Save these templates in your Study Hub or Digital Locker to structure 14-day exam blocks.
digitalContent.resourceText:
1. 7-3-1 Spaced Review Cadence: Review new lecture notes at 24h, Day 3, and Day 7.
2. Formula & Proof Sheet: Condense each unit to 1 single-sided sheet.
3. Timed Mock Sprint: Allocate 60% of final 5 days to timed past-paper problem sets.

catalog.name: ATS Resume & Technical Interview Kit
catalog.description: Curated engineering & internship resume bullet templates plus structured behavioral STAR prompts.

digitalContent.title: KAMPUS Career ATS & Interview Kit
digitalContent.instructions: Apply the Action + Metric + Context formula directly inside Career Hub Resume Builder.
digitalContent.resourceText:
Bullet Formula: [Strong Action Verb] + [Technical Artifact] + [Measurable Outcome].
STAR Method Checklist: Situation (15%) -> Task (15%) -> Action (50%) -> Quantified Result (20%).
